authorReviewNote: Hallownest explicitly kingdom in Nintendo official description. Hyrule/Azeroth/Tamriel different fantasy game worlds. Fallen/ruined setting corroborated developer premise. Correct proper noun, no hidden ending lore.

Publisher description explicitly insects and bizarre bugs. Other mammal/bird groups not primary visual inspiration. Many/and-other-bugs wording avoids false taxonomy of every creature, since fungi and other arthropods exist.
Valve official Portal 2 blog names Atlas and P-Body co-op science partners. Other robot/fiction pairs not this campaign. Correct hyphenation; does not confuse separate Chell single-player story.

Official Pokedex evolution row explicitly Sprigatito number0906 Grass, separate from Floragato and dual-type final evolution. Fire/water/electric wrong for unevolved first partner. No inference that all later evolutions remain single type.

Official press release explicitly Quaxly Duckling Pokemon. Owl/penguin/eagle different birds. Resembles avoids assertion fictional species is biologically a real duck, and first-partner wording correct.
